positive_snippets:
The hotel is located near Metro station and is located in the residential area. No signage boards are displayed and can be identified as A69 only. but the Google location is the most accurate. the rooms are spacious and basic amenities are available in the room. Limited parking space is also available.

The staff are really friendly and the room service staff are awesome in hospitality. Lots of options are available in the menu. Breakfast options should be improved.
Awesome stay, great foods, staff behaviour is very polite
A good hotel for a break and good staff and well kept .thanks
